cdx_query.snapshot_choice: per source URL and per year: the single LATEST snapshot with captured_at < sample_start (strict), statuscode 200, mimetype containing 'json'; no other snapshot may be chosen

sources.name: XRPScan account info (per cohort account)
sources.url_kind: template; {account} = cohort address from PROTOCOL §1 only
sources.key_field: account (must equal the URL account and the object's 'account'/'Account' field when present)

excluded_sources.name: Bithomp API /api/v2/address|username
excluded_sources.reason: requires x-bithomp-token header; an archive crawler cannot send it, archived bytes would be an error page

excluded_sources.name: HTML explorer pages (xrpscan.com/account, bithomp.com/explorer)
excluded_sources.reason: no fixed label field; review 0392 F1/F2 (row/cell attribution) cannot be enforced without a known schema

excluded_sources.name: Ripple Data API v2 /v2/gateways
excluded_sources.reason: lists IOU issuers, not exchange XRP deposit accounts

excluded_sources.name: Dune/third-party label tables, clustering, destination tags, LLM
excluded_sources.reason: no PIT timestamps or heuristic; forbidden by PROTOCOL §2

parse_rules: R1 Only the key_field/label_field pair is read; any other field or free text is ignored (0392 F2).
R2 Bytes that are not valid UTF-8 JSON of the declared shape => source yields no label for that year.
R3 normalize(name) = lowercase, Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse internal whitespace; nothing else (no suffix stripping).
R4 A name is an EXCHANGE label only if normalize(name) is EXACTLY one alias in exchange_allowlist; otherwise the account is 'unknown' (stays in the denominator).

R5 Conflict (0392 F1): if, for one account and year, the chosen snapshots of S1 and S2 (or duplicate S1 rows) give labels mapping to different entities, or one exchange and one non-allowlisted name => 'unknown'.
R6 One account appearing several times in S1 with the same entity is fine; desc is ignored.
R7 The allowlist and these rules are frozen with this commit; non-allowlisted names found later are only reported as a diagnostic, never added.
